notes.title: Linux Camera Fix / Minor improvements!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Resolved: We have been informed that our Linux version crashes during the very first scenario. After thorough investigations and testing, we were finally able to identify the issue and fix it!

However, if you encounter anything else that appears to be specific to the Linux version, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@magnolia.games.
[*]Resolved: At some point, the game gets stuck after clicking 'End Turn'. We detected the issue and were able to fix it.
[*]Optimized the displaying of ToolTips
[/list]

notes.title: Demon Loop is launching
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s finally time to take on the Demon Loop! We’re so happy to finally tell you that Demon Loop has launched onto Steam Early Access! We’re also launching with a 25% discount for the next week, so now’s the best time to pick up the game :)

We’re so excited to bring you our strategy, deck building adventure, and have lots more content planned for Early Access before our 1.0 launch!

Take a look below for our planned roadmap for Early Access

[b]Early Access Roadmap
[/b]
[list]
[*] New areas and levels to uncover and explore
[*] Story improvements
[*] More cards to collect, new effects and more stats to improve!
[*] The ability to customise your character
[*] Weekly and monthly challenges
[/list]

For now, following us on X/Twitter or Discord is the best way to stay notified of any updates and game progress. Wishlisting also helps out more than you know!

Thank you for your support so far! :D

notes.title: Demon Loop Demo played by developer Alexander Pfister
notes.content:
[h1]⚔️ Hey Hunters! ⚔️[/h1]

The demo for Demon Loop is out now, so feel as free as you can, grab your deck of cards as well as your demon fighting gear (maybe a snack while you’re at it) and go save the towns that are plagued by the demon arrivals.

[previewyoutube=TL1WXmZqt-s;full][/previewyoutube]

And not only that, but on wednesday, February 7th, 07:00 am PT (16:00 CET), the mind behind the Loop, Alexander Pfister, will join us for a livestream to talk about the game and where the future may lead it, so tune in to that!

Since it’s a demo, we would be more than happy for any kinds of feedback, so if you would like to add a little bit of your creativity and give us ideas or just generally want to tell us something, you can always join our Discord or send us a message on X, Instagram or TikTok!
